d:
Vada karo nahin chhoroge tum mera sath philm aa gale lag ja ka ek sadabhar romantik yugal git hai. is khubsurat git ko mahan gayak kishor kumar aur svar kokila lata mangeshkar ne apni madhur aavaz se amar bana diya hai. shashi kapur aur sharmila taigor ki shandar kemistri is git ko aur bhi yadgar banati hai.
Agar aapko purane hindi sadabhar git, 70 ke dashak ke romantik gane aur kishor kumar va lata mangeshkar ke suparhit duet pasand hain, to is git ko pura dekhen, laik karen, sheyar karen aur hamare chainal ko sabsakraib karna na bhulen.
git: vada karo nahin chhoroge tum mera sath
